objective: Exploratory classification of the recorded default_flag label in the Kaggle dataset.
calibration: none; no optional calibration search in this bounded experiment
family_search_rule: Maximize mean training-CV AP within family; tie order is declared parameter order

steps: Validation AP at least maximum minus AP tolerance
Among AP-eligible candidates, Brier at most minimum plus Brier tolerance
Prefer dummy, then logistic_regression, then random_forest
selection_rule.test_use: No selection, threshold tuning, recalibration or refit after frozen.json is written

bootstrap.method: Paired unstratified record bootstrap, percentile 95%, fixed fitted models

presentation_gate: Default appendix-only; no personal credit prediction interface without provenance/timing evidence
